title: Relative source flat locus is open and commutes with parameter base change
statement: Let $S,X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with morphisms $p:X\to S$, $q:Y\to S$ and $f:X\to Y$ satisfying $q\circ f=p$. Assume that $p$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and that $q$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Put $U=\{x\in |X|:f\text{ is flat at }x\}$. Then $U$ is open in $|X|$. For every morphism $h:T\to S$ of schemes, let $f_T:X\times_ST\to Y\times_ST$ and $\pi_X:X\times_ST\to X$ be the base-changed morphism and projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. The set of points where $f_T$ is flat is exactly $\pi_X^{-1}(U)$.

proof.text: Apply the compatible-affine-chart lemma at every $x\in X$. On each resulting chart $Z$, its open subset $E$ is exactly $U\cap Z$. Since these $Z$ cover $X$, the union of their open subsets $E$ is $U$. Thus $U$ is open in $X$.

proof.text: Fix any $h:T\to S$ and $x'\in X_T$, and put $x=\pi_X(x')$, $t=p_T(x')$, $s=h(t)=p(x)$. The universal fibrewise-flatness test gives $f_T\text{ flat at }x'\iff(f_T)_t\text{ flat at }\widetilde{x'}$ and $f\text{ flat at }x\iff f_s\text{ flat at }\widetilde x$, with all hypotheses valid over $T$.

source.place: Tag 05VJ, lemma-base-change-criterion-flatness-fibre, proof from the fibrewise description of U through the sentence that the hypotheses remain in force after base change; Tag 039C, theorem-criterion-flatness-fibre, structure-sheaf specialization, together with pointwise flat ascent.

proof.text: The residue-field homomorphism κ(s) → κ(t) makes κ(t) a vector space over κ(s). Mathlib Module.Free.of_divisionRing and Module.Flat.of_free give flatness directly. Flat.SpecMap_iff makes r = Spec(κ(t) ← κ(s)) flat; base-change stability applied to the cartesian fibre square for Y makes b:(Y_T)_t → Y_s flat. At z = p_T.asFiber(x′), pointwise flatness ascent and reflection in the square of step 5 give Flat(f_s at a(z)) iff Flat((f_T)_t at z). The projection identities give p.fiberι(a(z)) = π_X(x′) and p_T.fiberι(z) = x′. The equivalences from steps 3 and 4 therefore give Flat(f_T at x′) iff Flat(f at π_X(x′)). Extensionality proves the required equality of subsets.
